coverage.why: empireatx.com is fully unreachable: dig shows its DNS A records point directly at Cloudflare's own anycast IPs (172.67.149.245 / 104.21.29.231) rather than an origin server behind Cloudflare -- a classic 'orange-to-orange' DNS misconfiguration that Cloudflare itself refuses to serve (error 1000, 'DNS points to prohibited IP', https://developers.cloudflare.com/support/troubleshooting/http-status-codes/cloudflare-1xxx-errors/error-1000/). Confirmed independently via curl, WebFetch, and firecrawl_scrape (basic proxy) -- all three got the identical Cloudflare error page. This reads as a genuine, current outage of the venue's own site (as of 2026-09-24 ~21:15 UTC), not a bot block or a site closure -- Google/Bandsintown/Facebook/the Austin Chronicle calendar all still list empireatx.com as the live official site and the venue as operating. The natural fallback, Ticketmaster's venue page (ticketmaster.com/empire-control-room-garage-tickets-austin/venue/476109, found via web search), was not fetched: its robots.txt itself returned a bot-block response ({"response":"block"}), and per the fetching etiquette (no bypassing a block) that path was not pursued. Zero events could be read for this venue. This file should be re-run later once empireatx.com's DNS is fixed -- it is very likely a temporary misconfiguration, not evidence the venue lacks a real calendar.
